title: Rank Investments by Expected Value
real_world_story: An investment platform needs to display available investment opportunities in descending order of their expected portfolio value so that investors can quickly review the highest-value opportunities.

real_world_connection.target_represents: Investments arranged from highest expected value to lowest
real_world_connection.algorithm_represents: Sorting investment values in descending order

problem_statement: Given N investment opportunities and their expected values, arrange the investments in descending order of expected value and print the resulting sequence.
task: Sort the expected values of all investment opportunities from highest to lowest.
input_format: The first line contains an integer N, the number of investment opportunities. The second line contains N space-separated integers representing their expected values.
output_format: Print the expected values in descending order separated by spaces.

examples.explanation: The investment values are arranged from the highest expected value to the lowest.
Sorting the expected values in descending order produces the required ranking.

expected_algorithm.name: Sorting
expected_algorithm.reason: Sorting allows the investment platform to arrange opportunities according to their expected portfolio value.

hint: Read all expected values into an array.
Sort the array in descending order.
Print the sorted values in the required format.
real_world_takeaway: Sorting helps portfolio systems organize investment opportunities so that investors can quickly compare and review available choices.
